A quick-reference guide to safe, high-quality care when managing external ventricular drains.

```{ojs}
bestPracticesFirebase = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  return { db: getFirestore(app), collection, onSnapshot };
}
```

```{ojs}
function watchCollection(name) {
  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = bestPracticesFirebase.onSnapshot(
      bestPracticesFirebase.collection(bestPracticesFirebase.db, name),
      snapshot => notify(snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()).sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0)))
    );
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
doDonts = watchCollection("BestPracticesDoDonts")
```

```{ojs}
csfColors = watchCollection("BestPracticesCSFColors")
```

```{ojs}
// BestPracticesContent docs don't carry their own `id` field in
// Firestore (it's the document key) — read directly instead.
bestPracticesById = {
  const { doc, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");
  const ids = ["csf_caveat", "key_takeaway"];
  const result = {};
  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribes = ids.map(id =>
      onSnapshot(doc(bestPracticesFirebase.db, "BestPracticesContent", id), snap => {
        result[id] = snap.exists() ? snap.data() : {};
        notify({ ...result });
      })
    );
    return () => unsubscribes.forEach(u => u());
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
function renderCitations(block) {
  if (!block) return "";
  const citations = [];
  if (block.citationAuthors && block.citationTitle) {
    citations.push({ authors: block.citationAuthors, title: block.citationTitle, journal: block.citationJournalInfo, pmid: block.citationPmid });
  }
  if (block.citationAuthors2 && block.citationTitle2) {
    citations.push({ authors: block.citationAuthors2, title: block.citationTitle2, journal: block.citationJournalInfo2, pmid: block.citationPmid2 });
  }
  if (citations.length === 0) {
    return `<div class="fs-source" style="color:#c00;">⚠️ Citation needed</div>`;
  }
  return citations.map(c => `
    <div class="fs-source">
      📎 ${c.authors ? c.authors + " — " : ""}<strong>${c.title ?? ""}</strong>${c.journal ? " " + c.journal : ""}
      ${c.pmid ? ` <a href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/${c.pmid}/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">[PMID: ${c.pmid}]</a>` : ""}
    </div>
  `).join("");
}
```

## Do's and Don'ts

```{ojs}
doDonts.length === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading…</div>`
  : html`<table>
      <thead><tr><th>Do</th><th>Don't</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        ${doDonts.map(row => `
          <tr>
            <td><span class="mark-do">✔</span> ${row.doText ?? ""}</td>
            <td><span class="mark-dont">✖</span> ${row.dontText ?? ""}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join("")}
      </tbody>
    </table>`
```

## CSF Color Interpretation

```{ojs}
csfColors.length === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading…</div>`
  : html`<table>
      <thead><tr><th>CSF Appearance</th><th>Clinical Interpretation</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        ${csfColors.map(row => `
          <tr><td><strong>${row.appearance ?? ""}</strong></td><td>${row.interpretation ?? ""}</td></tr>
        `).join("")}
      </tbody>
    </table>`
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="callout-warning" style="padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;">
  <strong>Clinical Note:</strong> ${bestPracticesById.csf_caveat?.text ?? ""}
  ${renderCitations(bestPracticesById.csf_caveat)}
</div>`
```
